description: This file contains utility functions for file operations, including reading, writing, deleting files and directories, extracting zip files, and handling asynchronous operations with debouncing, specifically tailored for Electron-based desktop applications.

methods.name: debouncedJSONDiskWriter
methods.description: Creates a debounced function that writes JSON data to disk after a specified delay, preventing rapid successive writes.

methods.name: openDirectoryPicker
methods.description: Opens a dialog for the user to select a directory and returns the selected path.

methods.name: readJSONFile
methods.description: Asynchronously reads a JSON file and parses its contents.

methods.name: readJSONFileSync
methods.description: Synchronously reads and parses a JSON file.

methods.name: writeJSONFile
methods.description: Asynchronously writes data as JSON to a specified file, ensuring the directory exists.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Asynchronously writes string data to a specified file, ensuring the directory exists.

methods.name: writeJSONFileSync
methods.description: Synchronously writes data as JSON to a specified file.

methods.name: ensureDirectoryExists
methods.description: Recursively creates a directory and its parent directories if they do not exist.

methods.name: deleteDir
methods.description: Deletes a directory and its contents recursively.

methods.name: deleteDirContents
methods.description: Deletes all contents within a directory, handling concurrent modifications.

methods.name: moveDirContents
methods.description: Moves contents from one directory to another, avoiding nested moves.

methods.name: extractZip
methods.description: Extracts a zip archive to a destination directory.

methods.name: moveFiles
methods.description: Moves multiple files to a destination directory.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Deletes a file with retries to handle permission errors on Windows.
